players.product: AI cloud computing power (GPU clusters on long-term contracts) and the StarFlow Model-as-a-Service platform; the strategic cloud platform of the Xiaomi and Kingsoft ecosystem

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 interim results announcement: total revenues RMB5,775.7 million, up 33.7% from RMB4,319.2 million, mainly due to revenue growth from AI-related customers; public cloud services revenues up 46.2% to RMB4,353.9 million, mainly driven by growing demand for AI cloud services; enterprise cloud services RMB1,421.8 million (+6.1%). IDC costs rose 24.6% to RMB1,901.2 million and depreciation and amortization costs rose 91.6% to RMB1,782.6 million, mainly from newly acquired and leased servers and network equipment for the AI cloud business. As of June 30, 2026 the company owned two data centers and around 102,900 servers. Adjusted EBITDA RMB1,848.0 million, margin 32.0%.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB5,775.7 million (+33.7%); public cloud RMB4,353.9 million (+46.2%); ~102,900 servers
